facts.fact_text: On 16 February 2006 a gathering was held in Adana on the anniversary of the arrest of Abdullah Öcalan.
The applicant participated in the gathering held on 16 February 2006 in Adana.
Clashes occurred between police officers and some demonstrators who were attempting to block the traffic.
The police entered the Democratic Society Party (DTP) building following the clashes.
The police arrested 223 people, including the applicant, after entering the Democratic Society Party (DTP) building.
The day after the arrest, the applicant was detained on remand.
On 10 March 2006 the Adana public prosecutor charged the applicant and sixteen other people with membership of the PKK (Kurdistan Workers' Party) under Articles 220 § 6 and 314 of the Criminal Code.

Between 7 August 2003 and 18 July 2006, section 7(2) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act (Law no. 3713) provided that any person who assists members of terrorist organisations or who disseminates propaganda inciting others to violence or other methods of terrorism shall be liable to a term of imprisonment of between one and five years and a judicial fine of between five million liras and one billion liras.
On 10 September 2008 the Adana Assize Court convicted the applicant under section 7(2) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act (Law no. 3713).
The relevant domestic law applicable at the material time can be found in Belge v. Turkey (no. 50171/09, § 19, 6 December 2016).
Clashes occurred between police officers and some demonstrators who were attempting to block the traffic.
According to police reports, two police officers were injured as a result of objects thrown from the Democratic Society Party (DTP) building.
The Adana public prosecutor alleged that the accused had participated in the public gathering on 16 February 2006 in response to calls made by the PKK (Kurdistan Workers' Party).
The Adana public prosecutor alleged that the accused had resisted the police officers during the gathering on 16 February 2006.
The Adana public prosecutor alleged that the accused had therefore acted on behalf of the PKK (Kurdistan Workers' Party).

The Adana Assize Court considered that on 16 February 2006 the applicant had gone to the Democratic Society Party (DTP) building with a view to disseminating propaganda in support of the PKK (Kurdistan Workers' Party).
The applicant was sentenced to ten months' imprisonment by the Adana Assize Court.
The Adana Assize Court took into account the applicant's good behaviour during the trial when deciding to suspend the pronouncement of her conviction.
The Adana Assize Court took into account the absence of any previous criminal record on the applicant's part when deciding to suspend the pronouncement of her conviction.

The Adana Assize Court suspended the pronouncement of the applicant's conviction on condition that she did not commit another intentional offence for a period of five years, under Article 231 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (hükmün açıklanmasının geri bırakılması).
